home.description: Glutes, lower core, waist and fat loss for a complete beginner. Dumbbells, bands and a mat, 30-45 minutes. Two walking days, Sunday off.
home.goal: Get stronger, build my glutes, strengthen my core, and feel confident in my body.

guide.title: Daily habits for fat loss
items: Keep a sustainable calorie deficit if weight loss is the goal.
Give your muscles time to recover.

guide.title: Remember
items: Ab exercises strengthen your stomach, but they can't burn fat from one spot. Lower-belly and love-handle fat comes off with overall fat loss, strength training and consistency.

home.safety: Stop any exercise that hurts. If you notice abdominal doming, pelvic heaviness or leaking, pause that move and consider a pelvic floor physical therapist.

athletic.goal: Move like 30: a strong, mobile hip that is ready for the court.
athletic.safety: Hip rule: pain up to 3/10 that settles by the next morning is fine. Above that, or worse the next day: repeat the previous phase, or use ⋯ → Swap for a hip-friendly option. Stop anything sharp or pinchy in the front of the hip.

athletic.description: Three full-body days a week: trap bar, box squat and single-leg work instead of hip-pinching depth, plus press, pull and core. Heavier each phase; week 6 deloads.
equipment: Gym: trap bar, barbell, box, bench, dumbbells, cable/landmine, pull-up bar
athletic.goal: Full-body strength that carries over to the court, without beating up the hip.
athletic.safety: Hip rule: pain up to 3/10 that settles by the next morning is fine. Above that, or worse the next day: repeat the previous phase, or use ⋯ → Swap for a hip-friendly option. Stop anything sharp or pinchy in the front of the hip.

notes: Phase 1 (weeks 1-2): own the positions. Pick a load you could lift 3-4 more reps with.
Log the weight for every set. When you hit the top of the rep range on every set, add weight next time.

athletic.description: Two short sessions a week for basketball: learn to land and stop, then get springy, then move at game speed. Pairs with Total Body or Hip Function on a Mixed Week schedule.
athletic.goal: First step, stops and cuts that feel like 30 again.
athletic.safety: Hip rule: pain up to 3/10 that settles by the next morning is fine. Above that, or worse the next day: repeat the previous phase, or use ⋯ → Swap for a hip-friendly option. Stop anything sharp or pinchy in the front of the hip. Land softly; skip any jump that makes the hip pinch, and use the Phase 1 version instead.

notes: Phase 1 (weeks 1-2): landings and stopping. Quiet feet, hips back, knees over toes. Stick every landing.
Quality over fatigue: stop a set when reps get slow or sloppy. Do this on fresh legs, before lifting or on its own day.

bws_upper_warmup.name: Upper Body Warm-Up
bws_upper_warmup.note: Perform before any upper body, push, or pull workout

exercises.name: Arm Circles
exercises.notes: Swing arms in one direction for 5 reps then reverse.

exercises.name: Band Over-and-Backs
exercises.notes: Wide overhand grip, bring band over and behind body.

exercises.name: Band Pull-Aparts
exercises.notes: Overhand grip shoulder-width apart, pull band apart using mid-back muscles.

exercises.name: Band External Rotations
exercises.notes: Face sideways to band, lock elbow by side, rotate hand outwards then back in. Can use cables instead.

exercises.name: Weighted External Rotations
exercises.notes: Light weight, elbow locked, rotate hand up towards ceiling then back down.

bws_lower_warmup.name: Lower Body Warm-Up
bws_lower_warmup.note: Perform before any lower body or leg workout

exercises.name: Forward Leg Swings
exercises.notes: Hold onto a fixture, swing leg front and back as far as it will go.

exercises.name: Side Leg Swings
exercises.notes: Hold onto a fixture in front, swing leg side to side as far as it will go.

exercises.name: Deep Squat
exercises.notes: Hold weight plate in front, rock side to side over each ankle.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.notes: Keep core engaged, extend opposite arm and leg.

bws_daily_mobility.name: Daily Mobility Routine
bws_daily_mobility.note: Do daily — morning, break, or before bed. ~5 minutes.

exercises.name: Cat Cow
exercises.notes: As many quality reps as you can within 60 seconds.

exercises.name: Asian Squat
exercises.notes: Heels on rolled towel if needed.

exercises.name: Half Kneeling Thoracic Rotations
exercises.notes: Rotate upper body only, avoid rotating at hips.

exercises.name: Wall Slides
exercises.notes: Back flat, arms and hands in contact with wall.

bws_prehab.name: Prehab Routine
bws_prehab.note: Add after workouts or on rest days.

exercises.name: (Weighted) Prone Arm Circles
exercises.notes: Avoid arching back, arms extended, big circle forward and back. Start with 2.5-5lb.

exercises.name: Wall Slides
exercises.notes: Avoid arching back, press arms upward, stay in contact with wall.

exercises.name: Banded Hip Abductions
exercises.notes: 1 set torso forward, 1 set torso back. Can do standing with band at ankles.

exercises.name: Dead Hangs
exercises.notes: Overhand grip, relax whole body. Rest 30-60s between sets.

warmup_sets_protocol.note: Only for first upper and lower body exercise of the session. 1 optional warm-up set for remaining exercises.
